# CheckDR

> CheckDR is a free, browser-based suite of SEO and content-writing tools. The flagship tool checks Ahrefs Domain Rating for up to 100 domains at once. The suite also includes technical SEO auditing tools, on-page checks, content-writing analysis, and generators for schema markup, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, social previews, and hreflang tags.

## Domain & Technical SEO

- [Bulk Domain Rating Checker](https://checkdr.net/): Check Ahrefs Domain Rating for up to 100 domains at once, with sorting and CSV export.
- [Redirect Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/redirect-checker.html): Trace a URL's redirect chain and inspect the final HTTP status.
- [Meta Preview](https://checkdr.net/tools/meta-preview.html): Inspect a page's title, description, canonical tag, Open Graph/Twitter tags, robots meta, and H1 count.
- [DNS Lookup](https://checkdr.net/tools/dns-lookup.html): Look up A, AAAA, MX, TXT, and NS records for domains.
- [Broken Links Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/broken-links.html): Find broken links on a page.
- [Security Headers Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/security-headers.html): Check CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy headers.
- [SSL Certificate Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/ssl-checker.html): Look up domain certificate history through public Certificate Transparency logs.

## Content & Writing

- [Title & Meta Length Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/title-length-checker.html): Check title and meta description length and approximate Google SERP pixel width.
- [Readability & Keyword Density Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/readability-checker.html): Analyze pasted content for readability and keyword density.
- [Writing Clarity Checker](https://checkdr.net/tools/writing-clarity-checker.html): Analyze pasted text for passive voice and filler words.
- [Keyword Clustering](https://checkdr.net/tools/keyword-clustering.html): Cluster a pasted keyword list by lexical similarity and generate a content map.

## Generators

- [Schema Markup Generator](https://checkdr.net/tools/schema-generator.html): Generate JSON-LD for Article, FAQPage, Product, HowTo, LocalBusiness, and BreadcrumbList schema.
- [XML Sitemap Generator](https://checkdr.net/tools/sitemap-generator.html): Build a sitemap.xml from a pasted list of URLs.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://checkdr.net/tools/robots-generator.html): Generate robots.txt files, including presets for AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and CCBot.
- [Social & SERP Preview Builder](https://checkdr.net/tools/social-preview-builder.html): Preview how titles, descriptions, and images can appear in search and social results.
- [Hreflang Generator](https://checkdr.net/tools/hreflang-generator.html): Generate hreflang tags for multilingual pages.

## Tools Index

- [All Tools](https://checkdr.net/tools/): Full index of CheckDR's available SEO, technical, content, writing, and generator tools.

## General Information

- CheckDR does not require an account, login, or API key to use its tools.
- The Bulk Domain Rating Checker accepts up to 100 domains at once.
- Domain Rating data is provided through the Ahrefs Domain Rating API; CheckDR does not calculate Domain Rating itself.
- Client-side tools process pasted input in the browser and do not require a Cloudflare Worker.
- Tool-specific behavior, limitations, privacy practices, and acceptable use are documented on the relevant pages above.
